verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in post-call structured-data extraction (outcomes, entities, dispositions) and no API or registrable outbound webhook that delivers such data after a call. The nearest items do not qualify. Turn-event transcript collection and Flows functions that 'process data by interfacing with external systems' are developer building blocks, not the capability itself. The telephony 'webhook' is the carrier's inbound-call webhook, not an outbound post-call callback.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call
